class.name: NetwPersistenceConfig
class.brief_description: Everything one entity [Script] declares about how the server saves and restores its rows.
class.description: The policy is authored on a [Script] and read back for every node that script drives, because [method Netw.configure_persistence] runs from [method Object._init] while the flushing and the hydrating happen later, on the server, through [NetwPersistenceEngine]. Routing is a fact about the archetype rather than about one field, so the database and the table live here and every field marked [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] shares them. An author who declared nothing already carries a [member default_interval] of [code]5.0[/code] and a [member hydrate_on_spawn_enabled] of [code]true[/code]. Those are the policy a reader applies, not an absence it branches on: a script that names only a database and a table snapshots every five seconds and restores its saved row before the spawn frame is taken. [method record_id] records the method NAME and nothing else, so a config authored from one node's [Callable] never retains that [Node] and stays reusable for every later instance of the same script. The server resolves the name against the entity root when it needs a record id, and falls back to [member NetwEntity.entity_id] and then the node name when [member record_id_provider] is empty. [member db] is typed [Variant] because [NetwDatabase] is a GDScript class with no native counterpart, so the config carries whatever the author handed it without narrowing it, and GDScript resolves the real script type on the way back out. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(preload("res://data/game.tres")) \ .table(&"players") \ .interval(5.0) \ .record_id(_account_id) Netw.configure_property(self, &"gold").persisted() [/codeblock]

method.name: database
method.description: Declares the [NetwDatabase] every flush and hydrate reads and writes, into [member db]. Answers the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: hydrate_on_spawn
method.description: Declares [member hydrate_on_spawn_enabled]. Answers the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: interval
method.description: Declares [member default_interval]. Answers the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: record_id
method.description: Declares that [param callable]'s method on the entity root computes the record id rows are keyed by. Only [method Callable.get_method] is kept, into [member record_id_provider]. Answers the same config so the declaration chains.

method.name: table
method.description: Declares [member table_name]. Answers the same config so the declaration chains.

members.member: The [NetwDatabase] every flush and hydrate reads and writes, or [code]null[/code] for an archetype that persists nowhere. Typed [Variant] because [NetwDatabase] is a GDScript class, so the config holds the author's object without narrowing it. Declared through [method database].
Snapshot cadence in seconds for persisted columns that name no cadence of their own. Declared through [method interval].
When true, the server restores the saved row before the entity's SPAWN frame snapshots spawn state, so peers see the stored values from the first frame. Declared through [method hydrate_on_spawn].

Method called on the entity root to compute the record id, or empty to fall back to [member NetwEntity.entity_id] and then the node name. Declared through [method record_id], which is the only spelling that keeps the object out of the record.
Table the archetype's rows are keyed under. Declared through [method table].
